iniciarSesion.errorCredenciales: The email or password is incorrect.
iniciarSesion.errorServicio: We couldn't reach the sign-in service. Try again in a few minutes.
iniciarSesion.errorAccionRequerida: Your account needs an additional step before signing in. Contact the portal administrator.
iniciarSesion.errorSinRol: Your user has no role assigned in the portal. Contact the administrator.
iniciarSesion.registroAsegurado: Are you a policyholder without an account? Sign up in the Solventa app with your ID document and biometrics.

noAutorizado.mensaje: Your role is not allowed to view this page. If you think this is a mistake, contact the portal administrator.

sesionExpirada.mensaje: For your security we signed you out. Sign in again to continue.

contexto.conSolicitud: Home loan · Application No. {{numero}} · Mortgage life insurance

titulo.sinContexto: We didn't receive your loan details

descripcion.formulario: To calculate an offer tailored to you instead of a standard rate by age and amount, Solventa will access the following sources only with your express authorization.
descripcion.rechazado: Without your authorization we don't access any source.
descripcion.sinContexto: To authorize we need to know who you are and which loan this is about.
descripcion.error: Nothing was saved. You can try again.

kyc.descripcion: {{datos}} already carried out by the partner bank.

finalidad.perfilRiesgoVidaHipotecario: Calculation of the individual risk profile and of the mortgage life insurance offer

casillas.autorizo: I authorize Solventa to access my Open Finance and Open Data information for the purpose, scope and validity described. I can revoke this authorization at any time.
casillas.politica: I have read and accept the personal data processing policy.

registro.texto: It is saved with date, time, channel and scope; it is immutable and you will be able to view or revoke it from the portal or the Solventa app.

terminosActualizados.texto: The terms changed while you were reading them. Review them and authorize again.

rechazado.avisoTitulo: Without your authorization we can't calculate your offer
rechazado.avisoTexto: We don't access Open Finance, Open Data or your identity, and we can't personalize the insurance. You can change your mind at any time.

sinContexto.avisoTitulo: Go back to your bank's website
sinContexto.avisoTexto: Your application details didn't arrive. Start the insurance again from your bank's website to be able to authorize.

terminos.texto: Try again in a few seconds. No authorization was recorded.

registro.texto: Nothing was saved and we didn't access your data. Try again in a few seconds.

datos.titulo: Your application details are not valid
datos.texto: Check your application on your bank's website and start the insurance again. No authorization was recorded.

titulo.calculando: We are calculating your risk profile
titulo.error: We could not calculate your risk profile

descripcion.calculando: We query the sources you authorized and apply the pricing rules. This takes a few seconds; please keep this window open.
descripcion.listo: We finished querying the sources you authorized and applying the pricing rules. Review your personalized offer whenever you like.
descripcion.error: Your progress is saved. Review the notice and continue.

detalleFuente.tiempoAgotado: Did not respond in time · {{ms}} ms
detalleFuente.error: We could not query it · {{ms}} ms

perfilVigente.detalle: Calculated on {{fecha}} · no external sources were queried

perfilBase.detalle: You have no previous profile yet; it does not depend on external sources

fuentesNoResponden.titulo: If a source does not respond
fuentesNoResponden.texto: If a source takes more than 700 ms or is unavailable, we continue with your latest available profile or the base profile and let you know in the offer. You will never lose your progress.

lista.texto: We generated your personalized offer with the information we queried. Nothing is sent or charged until you review and accept it.

parcial.titulo: We calculated your profile with the sources that responded
parcial.texto: One or more sources did not respond in time, so your profile was calculated with the information available. You did not lose your progress.

ultimoPerfil.titulo: We are continuing with your latest profile
ultimoPerfil.texto: We could not query {{fuente}} right now. We used your latest profile, calculated on {{fecha}}, and your offer will be marked as provisional.

perfilBase.titulo: We are using the base profile
perfilBase.texto: We do not have a profile for you yet and could not query your sources right now. Your offer uses the base actuarial profile and will be marked as provisional; we will personalize it once the query is restored.

consentimiento.texto: To calculate your profile you must authorize querying your sources. We query nothing without your authorization.

error.titulo: We could not calculate your profile
error.texto: A problem occurred while calculating your profile. Your progress is saved; please try again.

datos.titulo: We could not generate your offer
datos.texto: The details of your loan are not valid for a quote. Contact your bank.

noDisponible.titulo: We could not generate your offer
noDisponible.texto: Try again in a few minutes.

generico.titulo: We could not generate your offer
generico.texto: An unexpected problem occurred. Please try again later.

oferta.primaNota: Added to your monthly loan payment
oferta.vigenciaValor: {{cantidad}} years · same as the loan term
oferta.perfilBase: Base actuarial · customer with no previous profile
oferta.avisoPrecio: Your price is calculated with your individual profile (age, financial habits and public sources), not with a standard rate by age and amount.
oferta.terminos: I accept the general and specific terms of the mortgage life policy and authorize charging the premium with my loan payment.
oferta.terminosError: You must accept the terms to continue.
oferta.primaNotaCache: With a cached profile · subject to requoting if you do not accept it
oferta.primaNotaBase: With the base profile · subject to requoting if you do not accept it
oferta.vigenciaMeses: {{cantidad}} months · same as the loan term

cache.titulo: We calculated your offer with your latest profile
cache.texto: We could not query {{fuente}} right now, so we used your latest profile, from {{fecha}}. If the information becomes available again, we will recalculate your offer and let you know.

base.titulo: We calculated your offer with a general profile
base.texto: We could not query {{fuente}} and we have no previous profile for you, so your offer was calculated with a general profile. If the information becomes available again, we will recalculate your offer and let you know.

condicion.vigencia24h: The offer is valid for 24 hours from the moment it is generated.
condicion.beneficiarioOneroso: The bank is the loss payee up to the outstanding loan balance.
condicion.primaMensual: The premium is charged monthly together with your loan payment.
condicion.recotizacion: If the information becomes available again, we will recalculate your offer and let you know.

noRegistrada.titulo: We could not register your acceptance
noRegistrada.texto: Please try again. Retrying is safe: your acceptance is never registered twice.

acciones.verPago: Check the status of your payment

datos.decisionRechazo: Risk not accepted by the advisor

validando.texto: Your acceptance was registered on {{fecha}}. We are validating your request…

conservada.texto: Your acceptance from {{fecha}} is saved. We had an issue and are resuming the process automatically; you do not need to repeat it.
conservada.avisoTexto: We keep trying without you having to do anything. If you close this window, you will see the status of your process when you return to this flow.

revision.texto: We registered your acceptance on {{fecha}}. Automatic underwriting asked for an additional validation, so a Solventa advisor will review your case. We usually respond within 4 business hours.

motivo.ofertaProvisional: Your offer was calculated with provisional information
motivo.perfilAdicional: Your profile requires an additional review

revision.avisoTexto: Offer {{oferta}} and its premium of {{prima}} are kept while the review lasts. No charge is made until the risk is accepted.

emision.texto: We registered your acceptance on {{fecha}} and underwriting approved your risk. We have started issuing your policy.

vencida.texto: Offer {{oferta}} expired on {{fecha}} and can no longer be accepted. We can generate a new one with your current profile; the price may vary.
vencida.textoSinFecha: Offer {{oferta}} has expired and can no longer be accepted. We can generate a new one with your current profile; the price may vary.

sinOferta.titulo: We could not find an offer to continue
sinOferta.texto: Get a new quote to receive an offer.

ofertaNoExiste.titulo: This offer does not exist or is no longer available
ofertaNoExiste.texto: Get a new quote to receive a valid offer.

noDisponible.titulo: We could not check your process
noDisponible.texto: If you already accepted the offer, your acceptance is still saved. Please try again in a few seconds.

generico.titulo: We could not process your request
generico.texto: An unexpected problem occurred. Please try again later.

ajustada.titulo: An advisor adjusted the terms of your offer
ajustada.texto: A Solventa advisor reviewed your request on {{fecha}} and adjusted the premium. Your previous acceptance is not charged. If you agree with the new terms, review and accept the new offer to continue. We also sent it to your email.
ajustada.avisoTexto: The new offer replaces {{oferta}}. The premium is only charged when you accept the new offer.

rechazada.titulo: We could not accept your insurance request
rechazada.texto: A Solventa advisor reviewed your request on {{fecha}} and the risk was not accepted. Nothing was charged. You can continue with your loan and the bank will tell you the next steps. We also sent it to your email.
rechazada.avisoTexto: Your request {{numero}} is closed. If you have questions, contact your bank or Solventa.

reemplazada.titulo: Your offer was updated with your real profile
reemplazada.texto: Offer {{oferta}} was provisional. Your financial information is now available and we recalculated your offer with your real profile. The previous offer can no longer be accepted.

noRenovable.titulo: You can no longer renew this offer
noRenovable.texto: Your details no longer meet the conditions to be insured. Contact your bank or Solventa.

noDisponible.titulo: We could not generate your new offer
noDisponible.texto: Try again in a few minutes. Trying again is safe.

generico.titulo: We could not generate your new offer
generico.texto: An unexpected problem occurred. Please try again later.

cargando.titulo: Checking the status of your payment

procesando.texto: Your acceptance was saved on {{fecha}}. We are charging the premium with an idempotency key that guarantees exactly one charge.

pendiente.texto: The payment gateway did not respond. Your acceptance was saved and we will retry the charge automatically until {{fin}}, with an idempotency key that guarantees exactly one charge. You do not need to repeat the process.

confirmado.texto: Your coverage became active on {{fecha}} and we are issuing your policy. We will send you the document by e-mail.
confirmado.activando: We received your payment. We are activating your coverage.

excepcion.titulo: We could not complete the charge
excepcion.ventana: The payment gateway did not respond during the retry period. An operations analyst will handle your case with you without losing your acceptance.
excepcion.rechazo: The gateway did not approve the payment. An operations analyst will contact you to continue without losing your acceptance.

datos.coberturaPendiente: Activated once the payment is confirmed

aviso.texto: We will let you know by e-mail when the payment is confirmed and the coverage is active. If it does not succeed by {{fin}}, the case goes to an operations analyst who will handle it with you without losing your acceptance.

sinAceptacion.titulo: We could not find your request
sinAceptacion.texto: Go back to the offer step to resume your process.

sinCobro.titulo: Your payment has not started yet
sinCobro.texto: The charge starts once your request is approved. Check the status of your acceptance.

generico.titulo: We could not check your payment
generico.texto: Your acceptance is still saved. Try again in a few minutes.

acciones.verAceptacion: Check the status of your acceptance
acciones.otroMedioNota: The payment method cannot be changed while the charge is running: the gateway has not answered and may already have taken it. It becomes available if the payment is declined.

medioDePago.numeroInvalido: Check the number: it is not a valid card
medioDePago.titularInvalido: Write the name as it appears on the card
medioDePago.pseAyuda: We will take you to your bank's portal to authorise the debit.
medioDePago.guardar: Save this payment method for renewals and claim payouts
medioDePago.cifrado: Encrypted payment · PCI DSS certified gateway · exactly one charge per acceptance
medioDePago.errorTarjeta: The gateway did not accept the card. Check the details and try again.
medioDePago.errorPasarela: We could not reach the payment gateway. Please try again in a moment.

capturando.texto: Your acceptance was registered on {{fecha}}. The charge is processed through the payment gateway and your coverage activates as soon as it is confirmed.
capturando.yaNoAdmite: This charge no longer takes another payment method. Hold on: the screen updates itself with its state.

rechazado.titulo: We could not process your payment
rechazado.avisoTitulo: The card issuer declined the payment
rechazado.texto: Your acceptance is still valid and the issuance is now an exception your operations team can see; you can try another payment method without starting over.

motivos.57: Transaction not permitted for this card
motivos.65: Exceeds the allowed number of transactions
motivos.otro: The bank did not authorise the charge

titulo.error: We could not show your policy

descripcion.cargando: One moment, we are checking the status of your issuance.
descripcion.esperando: Your coverage is active. In less than a minute you will have your contractual document and we will let you know by email.
descripcion.listo: Policy No. {{poliza}} · Coverage active since {{fecha}} · Issued without manual intervention
descripcion.error: Check the details and try again.

documento.generando: We are generating the document with your terms, coverages, premium and validity.
documento.disponible: General and special conditions · PDF · {{tamano}} · version {{version}} · also available in your portal

enviada.texto: We emailed you the issuance notification and the document on {{fecha}}.

pendiente.texto: We will email you a secure link to the document.

notificacion.reintentando: Sending the email is taking longer; we keep trying.

noEntregada.titulo: We could not deliver the email
noEntregada.texto: We could not email you the link. Your document is available: download it with this button.

app.titulo: Manage your policy from the Solventa app
app.texto: View your certificate offline, report claims with evidence from the place of the event and manage your data consents. Sign up with your ID and your biometrics.

polizaEmitida.pie: You will continue in Solventa's insured portal.

acciones.verPoliza: View my policy in the portal

error.noEncontrada: We cannot find an issuance for this policy yet. If you just paid, wait a few seconds and retry.
error.permiso: This policy is not linked to your session. Sign in with the insured's account.
error.generico: There was a problem checking your policy. Try again.
error.descarga: We could not download the document. Try again.

datosCliente.descripcion: Enter the customer's details, or recover them by document id, and get their quote with the same profiling engine as the embedded channels.
datosCliente.ayudaDocumento: Type the document without dots or hyphens. If the customer already exists, their data loads by itself.
datosCliente.ayudaMonto: Outstanding mortgage balance to insure, in COP.
datosCliente.consentimiento: The customer authorized access to their financial data to calculate their risk profile.

errorGeneral.servicio: We could not generate the quote. Check your connection and try again in a few minutes.
errorGeneral.permiso: Your session is not allowed to quote. Sign in again or contact the administrator.

busqueda.encontrado: Customer found: we loaded their data so you do not have to type it again.
busqueda.noEncontrado: No customer has that document. Fill in their details to register them when you quote.
busqueda.error: We could not look the customer up. Try again or fill in their details.

documento.invalid_format: The document must have 5 to 20 letters or digits, without dots or hyphens.

nombreCompleto.invalid_format: Enter the full name, with letters (3 to 120 characters).

correo.invalid_format: Enter a valid email, for example name@company.co.

fechaNacimiento.required: Enter the customer's date of birth.
fechaNacimiento.out_of_range: The customer must be between {{min}} and {{max}} years old for this insurance.

montoAsegurado.out_of_range: The amount must be between $ 10,000,000 and $ 2,000,000,000 COP.

plazoMeses.required: Enter the loan term in months.
plazoMeses.invalid_format: The term must be a whole number of months.
plazoMeses.out_of_range: The term must be between {{min}} and {{max}} months.

consentimiento.required: Confirm the customer's consent to be able to quote.

reglas.mismoMotor: The price uses the same profiling and rating engine as the embedded channel: no standard age-and-amount tariff.
reglas.vigencia: The quote is saved with an identifier and a 24-hour validity so it can be formalized later.
reglas.degradado: If an external source does not respond, the quote is generated in degraded mode with the last cached profile and you are told.
reglas.camposConError: Fields with errors prevent the quote from being generated.

generada.texto: It is valid until {{fecha}}. After that it cannot be formalized.

ultimoPerfil.texto: An external source did not respond, so the customer's last cached profile, from {{fecha}}, was used. The price is provisional.

perfilBase.texto: The external sources did not respond and the customer has no earlier profile, so the base actuarial profile was used. The price is not personalized.

vencida.texto: Its validity ended on {{fecha}}, so it cannot be formalized. Generate a new quote with the customer's data.

noEncontrada.titulo: We could not find the quote
noEncontrada.texto: The quote does not exist or the code is wrong. Generate a new one.

error.titulo: We could not load the quote
error.texto: There was a problem fetching the quote. Try again.

bandeja.descripcion: Requests that automatic underwriting routed to review. Sorted by arrival date; the origination flow continues automatically according to your decision.

registrada.descripcion: The decision for {{solicitante}} was recorded with its date, advisor and reason. The case left the pending list and the origination flow continues automatically.

vacio.pending: There are no requests pending a decision.
vacio.decided: There are no decided requests yet.
vacio.filtrado: There are no requests with this reason.

error.titulo: We could not load the inbox
error.texto: Try again in a few seconds.

detalle.yaDecidida: Another advisor already recorded the decision for this case. This is the decision in force.

explicacion.provisional_offer: The offer was priced in provisional mode because an external source did not answer. The customer sees the request under review and the price stays reserved.
explicacion.high_risk_score: The risk score of the profile is above the review threshold of automatic underwriting. The customer sees the request under review and the price stays reserved.
explicacion.generico: Automatic underwriting asked for an additional validation. The customer sees the request under review and the price stays reserved.

alRegistrar.texto: The origination flow continues automatically: if you accept, issuance starts; if you adjust, the customer gets the new terms; if you reject, the customer is notified. The decision is recorded with your name, the date and the reason, and the case leaves the pending list.

errorRegistro.titulo: We could not record the decision
errorRegistro.servicio: The service did not answer. You can safely retry: a case never ends up with two decisions.
errorRegistro.generico: An unexpected error occurred. Reload the page and try again.

noEncontrada.texto: We could not find this request in the inbox. Go back to the inbox to see the current requests.

error.titulo: We could not load the request
error.texto: Try again in a few seconds.

accept.descripcion: Issuance continues with the offered terms

adjust.descripcion: Surcharge on the premium · notes required

reject.descripcion: The customer is notified · notes required

ayudas.ajustePrimaPct: Only to adjust: surcharge from 0.01% to 100%

ajustePrimaPct.required: Enter the surcharge to adjust the premium.
ajustePrimaPct.rango: The surcharge must be greater than 0 and up to 100, with at most two decimals.

observaciones.required: Write the notes: they are required to adjust or reject.
